'''Thomas Harris''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Colorado State Championship]] on 31 March 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM Royal Guards]], according to Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2002">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-states-return-co-state-championshipd2002/ states-return-co-state-championship], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-states-return-co-state-championshipd2002/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
